content: I've been alternating days here on my blog. One day, lots of posts, maybe even a podcast. And then a quiet day. Lots of stuff was going on here, I was trying to work out a feature for WordLand that isn't cooperating, having to do with the clipboard and the MediumEditor package. It does all these nice things for us with the clipboard, but it isn't willing to share custody. A feature request is that when you paste a URL and there's a selection, the text is turned into a link. I've burned two full sessions on this, seeking advice from ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. The clipboard is one of those areas of the browser that is held together with rumors and confusion. Tomorrow I'm going to work on other things, and the day after until I have an idea for another way to approach this. BTW, we could use a few more testers with good experience with bug reporting and using WordPress. I'm sure there are more bugs I haven't gotten reports on yet.
